correctness.rationale: An exact two-stage Fourier transformation yields the full spectrum \(a|D_{q_u}(\omega_b^j)|^2\), including multiplicities and singular endpoint fibers; the gcd basis criterion follows. A strict sampled Dirichlet inequality is proved by monotonicity of \(\sin t/t\) for even block lengths and nearest rational-grid points plus a uniform cosine bound for odd lengths (including length three). Each admissible block length at least three has a strictly larger condition number than a length-two block. Mixtures of block lengths one and two attain the sharp bounds \(A=4a\sin^2(\pi/(2b))\), \(B=4a\). A standalone checker passed 162937 finite checks, but no finite computation is used as a universal proof.

value.rationale: Strictly overlapping boxcars are a canonical finite Gabor measurement design. The exactly optimal and unavoidable loss for positive overlap is a natural stability invariant, not a normalization trick: the theorem answers every integer length and gives a complete set of extremizers, plus the sharp high-fiber asymptotic \(4b^2/\pi^2+1/3+O(b^{-2})\). A nontrivial sampled Dirichlet-kernel extremal lemma distinguishes the result from generic diagonalization or a finite table calculation.
